Presolicitation Notice
Solicitation: 36C10D23Q0109
This is a FAR 13 Simplified Acquisition Procedures Solicitation
Type of Solicitation: 100% Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) set-aside
Location of Solicitation: Opportunities (Formally Known as: FBO)
NAICS: 516210
PSC(s): 7A21
Description:  Media Reporting Subscription (Brand Name or Equal)
Quote due: 09/25/2023@09:00 eastern time with completed and signed copy of solicitation.
Contracting Officer: Tina Angela Brooks, tina.brooks@va.gov
See Solicitation 36C10D23Q0109 for more details.  Questions asked after September 21, 2023, will not be answered.
Interested Party requirements:
Vendors must have active registrations in SAM.gov and SBA.gov well as have current, updated information actively vendorized with the Financial Service Center (FSC).  Award will not be held for vendors who do not comply with the solicitation.
Evaluation Criteria:
Quotes will be evaluated in accordance with FAR 13.106-2 Evaluation of quotations or offers.
Evaluation will be Best Value to the Government
Quotes will be evaluated for the fair and reasonable price.
